question: Which Indian union territory has ‘Dugong’ as the state animal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andaman Nicobar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ‘Dugong’ as the state animal of Andaman Nicobar.
 
• Dugongs are mammals, which means they give birth to live young and then produce milk and nurse them.
 
• It is the flagship animal of** Gulf of Mannar Marine National Park.**
 
• Once the female is pregnant, she will carry the unborn baby, called a foetus for 12-14 months before giving birth.
